catalog.title: Assess successive lenses on held-out text
catalog.mac: Research methods: Author request, review inputs, then open execution and evidence. Both CLIs use science interview/draft/publish and the same managed engine.
outputs: Measure agreement between two lenses and with the model’s actual final residual on declared held-out token positions.
catalog.restriction: Uses reviewed inputs and immutable scientific outputs. No environment installation, automatic retries, or scientific qualification.

actions.authorityReason: Inspect staged scientific inputs and execution resources without execution or authorship.
Execute a reviewed scientific operation and retain its scientific output type.

access.restriction: Calls the existing route with its existing service role and scientific gates. Request path parameters, query and body remain explicit; this adapter does not change execution topology or retry mutations.

interview.title: Assess successive lenses on held-out text
interview.purpose: Measure agreement between two lenses and with the model’s actual final residual on declared held-out token positions.

fields.label: Model to fit
fields.help: Choose a prepared Hugging Face checkpoint. Fitting does not download model weights or change them.

fields.label: Exact model version
fields.help: Inspect the model to pin its 40-character commit. The resulting lens belongs to this checkpoint.

fields.label: Held-out text corpus
fields.help: Unique id and text per JSONL row. Choose text not used for fitting or method selection; a different file hash alone does not prove independence.

fields.label: Reference registered lens
fields.help: Choose the earlier fit or comparison instrument from the lens library.

fields.label: Candidate registered lens
fields.help: Choose the later fit or merged round from the same model and known model revision.

fields.label: Maximum passages to assess
fields.help: Uses the first N rows in this declared assessment corpus.

fields.label: Maximum tokens per passage
fields.help: Raw text, with the prepared tokenizer’s native special tokens.

fields.label: Leading positions to omit
fields.help: Early positions and the final token are excluded.

fields.label: Maximum assessed positions per passage
fields.help: Uses the first eligible positions and records them. Vocabulary logits are processed in small chunks.

fields.label: Top tokens to compare
fields.help: Reports top-k set overlap and Jensen–Shannon divergence, averaged equally over the recorded token positions.

fields.label: Model precision
fields.help: Use the prepared, unquantized runtime appropriate to the intended readout.

fields.label: Execution device
fields.help: cuda, mps, or cpu; this assessment does not download weights.

interview.claimBoundary: Coverage and readout stability must be interpreted for the selected corpus and runtime. Outputs do not establish behavioral validity.
questions: Which corpus range and resource budget answer the research question?
Which missing coverage or readout differences would change the conclusion?
